items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: It was written for Al by Ferde Grofe back in the 1950s.

ctx.x: Under the conductor Steve Richmond. And what Steve does is take old arrangements, what he’s taking Paul Whiteman arrangements, and he’s replicating them very authentically so that’s why he had contacted Al. Originally he contacted him two years © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-

ago and Al did a recording with him of “Fascinating Rhythm” which was from an old Whiteman arrangement. And they also recorded the “Gallodoro Serenade” with Lincoln Mayorga on piano. It was written for Al by Ferde Grofe back in the 1950s.
